headline: Target-bound Supabase and Cloudflare release authority is fully deployed; identical commit-bound bytes, six headers, quota, capture, and rendered landing proof are green from staging through production.

items.title: Target-verified Supabase deployment authority
items.insight: Provider mutation is safe only when credentials, project identity, remote inventory, and receipt target agree.
items.evidence: Two migrations applied, five functions ACTIVE, authenticated quota exhaustion HTTP 429, target fjnpzjjyhnpmunfoycrp.

items.title: Cloudflare dual-origin release plane
items.insight: One content-addressed artifact can separate technical deployment confidence from launch-policy approval while retaining a distinct rollback origin.
items.evidence: Commit 7a6a3a2 digest 82f29e7c...18ab is identical on staging and production; root, health, three deep routes, seven files, six headers, dark/light, mobile overflow, and 44x44 targets pass.

items.title: Privacy-preserving capture proof
items.insight: Insert-only public capture should prove persistence through privileged readback, never by granting anonymous SELECT.
items.evidence: Anonymous insert HTTP 201, privileged observation HTTP 200, cleanup HTTP 204; receipt stores only an email hash.

items.title: Human boundary release court
items.insight: Technical deployment may proceed while SPARKED stays HOLD on later external proofs; permission is not evidence.
items.evidence: Independent app-release recheck is technically GREEN; external mailbox, identity, payment, tester, remediation, cost, and post-proof approval criteria remain explicit.
